name: GuardDuty IP Trust List Evasion
description: GuardDuty allows trusted IP lists that suppress findings from specified IP ranges. An attacker with guardduty:CreateIPSet or guardduty:UpdateIPSet adds their IP or CIDR range to a trusted list. Findings from that IP are then suppressed. The attacker creates a new IP set or updates an existing one with their address. Required permissions are guardduty:CreateIPSet and guardduty:UpdateIPSet. The IP set must be associated with the detector.
